candidates.label: HP-triage retreat: low HP → very wide 280-360 ranged kite (targets low-durability cell)
candidates.rationale: All 3 current elites sit in durability bin 3 (high HP preserved). This candidate intentionally targets durability bin 0-1 by retreating to extreme range when wounded, trading durability for survival-at-extreme-standoff. Should produce a descriptor in {engage:0, durability:0-1} that is currently empty.

candidates.label: Aggressive execute rush: always tight 30-70 (targets high-engage, low-efficiency cell)
candidates.rationale: All elites in engage bin 1-2. This commits to engage bin 0 (very close). Short range stacks hits but eats enemy burst — expected to drop efficiency into bin 1-2 (whiffs more under pressure) while maximizing engage. Should fill engage=0 column.

candidates.label: Patience mid-poke: Q cooling → wait at 180-240 (targets low-tempo cell)
candidates.rationale: All elites in tempo bin 2-3 (fast-acting). This candidate stalls at mid range when Q is cooling — intentionally slow tempo. Should land in tempo bin 0-1 with durability still high. Fills low-tempo axis.

candidates.label: Stomp-aware dodge wave: stomp>0.3 → very wide 260-340 + lower role; else tight (targets low-efficiency)
candidates.rationale: Oscillates between extreme ranges based on _stomp engine signal. Reactive wide-retreat when enemy sharpens should increase negated/dodged% → push efficiency down into bin 1-2. Expected descriptor: engage moderate, tempo high, efficiency LOW — new cell.

candidates.label: Closing-phase REVERSE split: when closing>0.3 go wide (not tight) — anti-execute (targets low-engage)
candidates.rationale: Inverted intuition from pack-count-robust/alternating-oscillator. When the engine says we're winning (_closing high), pull back to 220-290 instead of pressing — trades execute-tempo for survival. Should land in engage bin 0-1, tempo bin 1-2, durability bin 3. Explores whether patience-in-winning is a valid policy class.
